record.title: Nullity conjecture for even hyperbanana rigidity matrices
record.statement:
An **even hyperbanana** is the graph $H^+_{d,b}$ embedded in $\mathbb{R}^d$ with $d=2b$ and $b\geq 2$. Its rigidity matrix records the infinitesimal edge-length constraints of the embedding. **Even hyperbanana nullity conjecture.** The rigidity matrix of $H^+_{d,b}$ has nullity exactly

$$
\binom{d+1}{2}+\binom{b}{2}.
$$

For odd-dimensional hyperbananas, the corresponding nullity was proved in the paper, whereas an exact analysis for even hyperbananas remains open because of the additional $d/2$ edges. The conjecture is based on Mathematica calculations for randomized embeddings.
record.source_name: Christopher Clement, Audrey Lee-St. John and Jessica Sidman, “Hyperbanana Graphs”, arXiv:1308.3281 (2013).
record.references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1308.3281

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of August 2013).
